# dreamrouter_port_forwards (Data Source)

Lists the router's port forwarding rules, including those made in the web UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dreamrouter_port_forwards" "all" {}

# Which ports are open to the internet right now.
output "open_ports" {
  value = [for f in data.dreamrouter_port_forwards.all.port_forwards : "${f.protocol} ${f.port} -> ${f.forward_ip}:${f.forward_port}" if f.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `port_forwards` (Attributes List) All port forwarding rules, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--port_forwards))

<a id="nestedatt--port_forwards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `port_forwards`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `forward_ip` (String) LAN address it forwards to.
- `forward_port` (String) Port on forward_ip.
- `id` (String) The rule's ID.
- `log` (Boolean) Whether connections are logged.
- `name` (String) The rule's name.
- `port` (String) Port, range or list on the router's internet side.
- `protocol` (String) "tcp", "udp" or "tcp_udp".
- `source` (String) Who may connect: "any", an address or a network.
- `wan` (String) "wan", "wan2" or "both".
